protocol.decision: completed daily bar t; features use only bars up to t; available at t+1 00:00 UTC
protocol.target: Z_h = (log close_{t+h} - log close_t) / (s_t sqrt(h)); UP if Z>0.75, DOWN if Z<-0.75, else NEUTRAL
protocol.scale: s_t = EWMA of squared daily log returns, half-life 21 days

features.price: m1 m3 m7 m21 accel3 eff7 breakout21 compression3_21 log_risk21 relvol3 close_loc causal_age
features.funding: funding3 z90 and 7-day change (spot not available: no cached spot klines)
features.flow: perp taker-buy ratio 3d and 21d (cached futures klines; OI not cached for 2020-2021)

protocol.test: 90-day blocks from 2021-01-01 to 2024-12-31; labels needing 2025 data are dropped (sealed)
protocol.purge: training pool requires t+7 < block_start-8 (7-day label horizon + 8-day embargo)
protocol.calibration: last 90 days of pool; stopping: previous 90 days (XGB rounds only); temperature scaling
protocol.costs: fee+slippage 4+2 bp per side on entry and exit; funding paid over held days
protocol.gate: precision>=0.80, Wilson lower>=0.70, realized coverage>=0.10, UP+DOWN recall>=0.20, alarms>=100, >=4 blocks with alarms, precision above persist_m3 at the same coverage, net mean block-CI lower>0
protocol.deviation: history starts 2020-01-01: the 24-month warm-up is impossible; first blocks have thin fit sets

xgb_price/h7.stopping_fallback: class missing in fit or stopping segment; fixed 64 rounds

xgb_full/h7.stopping_fallback: class missing in fit or stopping segment; fixed 64 rounds
